title: Reasons of the Monastic Life
author: Evagrius Ponticus
blurb: A guide to monastic life explaining why celibacy and simplicity matter, with practical advice on letting go of worldly concerns.
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Evagrius Ponticus’s Rerum monachalium rationes — new OET from PG 40 Greek (Khazarzar). Modern English syncs were not used as wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew densify. SERIES CLOSEOUT.
